meta.name: Test Writer
meta.description: Find untested code paths in dazl-pr-panel-sandbox and add node:test tests that follow the repo's conventions, reviewed until they pass and assert real behavior.

nodes.title: Start with a scope
nodes.description: Optionally name a file, folder or feature; without one the whole app is covered.

nodes.title: Find gaps and write tests
nodes.description: Inventory untested paths, rank them by risk, add *.test.js files.
nodes.prompt: Add tests for the scope in the request. Done when the highest-risk untested paths have tests, npm test passes except for tests marked as reported bugs, npm run build passes, and the output lists the paths still untested with reasons.

nodes.title: Review the new tests
nodes.description: Checks the tests pass, assert real behavior and follow the conventions.

reviewers.prompt: Review the tests the Test Writer added: run npm test, check each expectation is correct and can fail, and check the high-risk paths are covered or explained.
